item.title: Australia plans mandatory safety rules, new regulator for frontier AI companies
item.dc:creator: Ann Mary Peter
item.description:
Australia will require frontier AI developers to report serious incidents to a new regulator.

The post Australia plans mandatory safety rules, new regulator for frontier AI companies appeared first on MEDIANAMA.

item.title: CCPA fines Justdial Rs 10 lakh over ammonium nitrate listings, rejects intermediary defence
item.dc:creator: Rohit Singh
item.description: The CCPA fined Justdial Rs 10 lakh for listing ammonium nitrate without verifying sellers' licences or disclosing legal restrictions, ruling that the listings amounted to misleading advertisements.
